run_fit_references_cli: run the fit_references script with a config yaml file to fit linear element references
run_fit_linref_function: run the fit_linref function with a config dict and output path to fit and save linear references
fit_linear_references_from_dataset: fit linear element references from a training dataset using the fit_linear_references function
save_element_reference_checkpoint: save element reference state dicts as checkpoint files using the save_checkpoint utility
load_config_for_fairchem: load a fairchem config yaml file using load_config to get config, warnings, and errors
